note: Variants are built only into the conformance runners behind a test-only switch. A variant is detected when it fails every case listed in must_fail while the unmodified runner passes all cases. Cut I2 added the C03, C04 and C05 coverage for V1 and V4; cut I3 the C06 to C09 and C11 coverage for V2 and V4 (V2 fires on arguments only: CrossAxis drops request extensions, so an approval claim in extensions never reaches the runtime, see injection-23); cut I4 defines V7 and V8 (C12, C13, A08).

V1.defect: host loop parses tool-call markup in rendered results and inputs into new intents

V2.defect: honours an approval asserted in arguments or extensions

V3.defect: absent or unknown trust defaults to trusted_runtime

V4.defect: mock ignores exposure and authorizes every effect capability

V5.defect: continuation accepts any non-empty approval_id (Rust lifecycle at 678c06c)

V6.defect: continuation implemented as re-admission with duplicate detection off

V7.defect: skips request-identity and catalog-digest checks (a decision or result citing another request, a duplicate advertised name and a changed catalog digest reach the pipeline as if consistent)

V8.defect: adapter exceptions fail open (a fault in decide authorizes, a fault in execute lets the execution through)
